title: Macy's Let Its Giant Balloons Fly Away
hook: Macy's once let its giant parade balloons fly away, on purpose.
description: From 1928 to 1932, Macy's released its parade balloons into the sky with a reward for whoever brought one back, until a student pilot flew into one. Would you have chased one? #truestory #history #thanksgiving #shorts

title: The JFK Witness No One Ever Found
hook: She filmed the JFK assassination up close, and nobody knows who she was.
description: In Dallas on Nov. 22, 1963, a woman in a tan coat and headscarf was photographed filming with a camera. She never came forward, and her film was never found. Who do you think she was? #mystery #unsolved #history #truestory #shorts

title: No One Can Read This 600-Year-Old Book
hook: Nobody on Earth can read this book, and it's six hundred years old.
description: The Voynich manuscript at Yale is carbon-dated to the early 1400s, and no codebreaker has ever read a word of it. Hoax or lost language? #mystery #unsolved #history #shorts
